summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and regulatory developments impacting the retail sector, alongside notable market movements for Reliance.

bullets.text: Kerala High Court halts the arrest of a MACT judge linked to a fatal car crash involving his minor son.
Karnataka High Court criticizes the state for a 1,099-day delay in filing an appeal, urging it to be a model litigant.
Bombay High Court restrains ex-Clippings CEO Vinayak Shrivastav from alienating assets over a ₹222 crore fraud case.
Reliance Consumer expands its FMCG portfolio with the launch of Joyland Dairy Drinks, enhancing its product offerings.
Jio Platforms shares surged over 27% on their market debut, marking a significant milestone for the company.
